description: This is a Flutter widget class that represents a screen displaying a list of medical records. It interacts with various providers for authentication, patient data, and medical records. It handles navigation, loading states, and displays individual medical record cards.

classes.name: MedicalRecordsListScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that displays a list of medical records, handling user authentication state and loading data from providers.
